chapter_note: Strongly substrate-dominant chapter. Two Q&A units: one about the Father of Life pouring forth the three Mighty Ones (Mother/Darkness/Fire), and one about the strongholds surrounding the cosmos. Both questions are substantive cosmological queries about the formation of the three earths, firmaments, fossae, and the purification process. The substrate maps cosmos→cosmos throughout: water/darkness/fire poured from heaven, drawn up by their kindred below, gathered and cast outside the cosmos. Editorial frame is minimal: opening dialogue formula, two question-introductions, and two response-introductions. The Omophoros appears at the close. No institutional/ecclesial overlay; no polemic.
